title: Monitoring Desk Standing Order — Watching, Acknowledging and Responding to Alarms under the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Monitoring Desk Standing Order — Watching, Acknowledging and Responding to Alarms under the Building Automation Service Plans

1. Alarms from a site covered by a Building Automation Service Plan are watched only where the tier includes monitoring, and only during the tier's monitoring hours.
2. A critical or urgent alarm is acknowledged inside the tier's acknowledgement target, counted in elapsed minutes from the moment the alarm was raised, and the desk then either clears it remotely, calls the building contact, or dispatches, in that order.
3. Each alarm the desk acts on consumes one of the plan year's included responses; alarms the system clears by itself and alarms the desk suppresses as nuisance consume none. The responses used in the plan year are the count of responses the desk acted on from the term start date through the term end date inclusive.
4. Once the year's responses are used up, each further response carries the tier's overage fee.
5. An after-hours call-out on a critical alarm is included only where the tier includes it; at every other tier the call-out is dispatched as demand service and billed at the demand rates.
6. Repeated nuisance alarms are tuned out at no charge where the tier includes tuning, and where it does not, tuning is quoted as controls work.

The tier figures these orders turn on — whether monitoring is included, the acknowledgement target in minutes, the included responses per plan year, the response overage fee and whether the critical alarm call-out is included — are those of the monitoring desk schedule.

## Which alarms draw a response

| Event at a monitored site | Draws one included response |
|---|---|
| Desk clears the alarm remotely | yes |
| Desk calls the building contact | yes |
| Desk dispatches | yes |
| System clears the alarm by itself | no |
| Desk suppresses the alarm as nuisance | no |

## Acknowledgement target (hypothetical)

An urgent alarm raised at 02:10 at a tier whose target is 45 minutes is acknowledged inside the target if acknowledged by 02:55, since the target is counted in elapsed minutes from the moment the alarm was raised. A tier that watches alarms only during business hours does not watch that alarm at 02:10 at all.

## Overage (hypothetical)

A plan with 24 included responses whose desk has already acted on 24 alarms this plan year carries the tier's overage fee on the twenty-fifth response.
